exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 Who Do You Admire?
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Tom, our teacher asked us to talk about a person we admire. Who will you choose?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: I'd like to talk about Tu Youyou. She discovered a new medicine for malaria.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: Oh, the scientist who won the Nobel Prize? Why do you admire her?

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Because she never gave up. Her team failed many times before they succeeded.

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: That's true. I think I'll choose Florence Nightingale.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: The nurse? Why her?

transcript.speaker: Lily
transcript.text: She cared for wounded soldiers and founded modern nursing. She was very brave.

transcript.speaker: Tom
transcript.text: Great choice. Both of them helped a lot of people.

exercises.translation_cn: 老师让谈一位敬佩的人。Tom 选屠呦呦,因为她发现治疟疾的新药、屡败屡战从不放弃;Lily 选南丁格尔,因为她照料伤兵、创立现代护理、很勇敢。两人都帮助了许多人。

questions.stem: Who does Tom choose to talk about?
Why does Tom admire her?
options: She never gave up after failing.

questions.stem: Who does Lily choose?
What did Lily's person do?
options: She cared for soldiers and founded nursing.

questions.stem: What do Tom and Lily agree about the two people?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 The Meaning of Greatness
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: When we hear the word great, we often think of famous people.
But Einstein once said we should become a person of value, not just a person of success.
This means that helping others matters more than fame or money.
A kind teacher or a brave doctor can be great in a quiet way.
Greatness, then, is really about caring and never giving up.
exercises.translation_cn: 听到'伟大'我们常想到名人;但爱因斯坦说要做有价值的人,而非只追求成功;这意味着帮助别人比名利更重要;善良的老师、勇敢的医生也能以平凡的方式伟大;伟大其实关乎关爱和永不放弃。

questions.stem: What do people often think of when they hear 'great'?
What did Einstein say we should become?
options: A person of value, not just success.

questions.stem: What matters more than fame or money?
Who can be great in a quiet way?
options: A kind teacher or a brave doctor.

questions.stem: What is greatness really about?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 An Interview About the Discovery
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Professor, can you tell us how the new medicine for malaria was found?

transcript.speaker: Guest
transcript.text: Of course. The team read more than two thousand old Chinese medical texts.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Two thousand? That sounds like a huge amount of work.

transcript.speaker: Guest
transcript.text: It was. They also tested hundreds of plants, but at first nothing worked.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: So what was the key to success?

transcript.speaker: Guest
transcript.text: They drew out the extract at a lower temperature, and then it finally worked.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Amazing. How many times did they fail before that?

transcript.speaker: Guest
transcript.text: More than a hundred and ninety times. They never gave up.

exercises.translation_cn: 主持人请教授讲新疟疾药如何被发现。团队读了两千多部中医古籍、测试数百种植物,起初都无效;关键是在较低温度提取提取物才成功;在此之前失败了190多次,但从不放弃。

questions.stem: How many old texts did the team read?
What happened when they first tested the plants?
What was the key to success?
options: Drawing out the extract at a lower temperature.

questions.stem: How many times did they fail?
What does the guest say about the team's spirit?

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Trusted Doctor
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Zhong Nanshan is a doctor whom many Chinese people deeply trust.
During a dangerous outbreak, he stayed calm and told the public the truth.
He insisted on treating the most serious patients himself.
Years later, even in his eighties, he stepped forward to help again.
His courage and honesty make him a model of a great person.
exercises.translation_cn: 钟南山是许多中国人深深信任的医生;危险爆发期间他保持冷静、说出真相;坚持亲自救治最重的病人;多年后年逾八旬仍挺身相助;他的勇气与诚实使他成为伟人的典范。

questions.stem: How do many people in China feel about Zhong Nanshan?
options: They have never heard of him.

questions.stem: What did he do during the dangerous outbreak?
options: He stayed calm and told the truth.

questions.stem: Which patients did he insist on treating?
What did he do years later in his eighties?
options: He stepped forward to help again.

questions.stem: What makes him a model of a great person?

exercises.title: U1 听力·对话 How to Write About a Hero
exercises.speaker: uk_female

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: I have to write an introduction about someone I admire, but I don't know how to start.

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: First, choose a person and say why he or she is great.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Okay. Then what should I write about?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Tell an impressive story from the person's life. Stories make readers care.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: Should I describe what the person looks like too?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Yes, a little. Describe the appearance and the personality.

transcript.speaker: Anna
transcript.text: And how should I end it?

transcript.speaker: Ben
transcript.text: Sum up how you feel about the person. That makes a strong ending.

exercises.translation_cn: Anna 要写敬佩之人的介绍却不知如何开头。Ben 建议:先选人并说明为何伟大;再讲一个动人的生平故事;适当描写外貌和性格;最后总结自己对此人的感受作为有力结尾。

questions.stem: What is Anna's problem?
options: She doesn't know how to start writing.

questions.stem: What does Ben say to do first?
options: Choose a person and say why they are great.

questions.stem: Why does Ben suggest telling a story?
What does Ben say about describing the person?
How should Anna end the introduction?
options: By summing up how she feels.

exercises.title: U1 听力·短文 A Famous Saying
exercises.speaker: uk_female
transcript: Here is a famous saying from Albert Einstein.
He said we should try not to become a person of success, but a person of value.
In other words, do not work only for fame or money.
Instead, do something good and useful for other people.
If we live this way, our lives will truly have meaning.
exercises.translation_cn: 这是爱因斯坦的一句名言:不要只想成为成功的人,而要做有价值的人;换句话说,别只为名利而努力;要为他人做一些有益的事;若这样生活,我们的人生才真正有意义。

questions.stem: Whose saying is this?
What kind of person should we try to become?
What should we NOT work only for?
What should we do instead?
What will happen if we live this way?
options: Our lives will truly have meaning.
